# Verify Report: #456 slice A — the SDD stage set becomes data

**Change**: issue-456-stage-set
**Worktree verified**: /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-456 (branch feat/issue-456-…, off origin/main @ b6f9dd8)
**Mode**: full artifacts (spec + design + tasks + apply-progress) — read against the CURRENT (twice-amended) spec.md text.
**Verdict: PASS. No CRITICAL findings. One WARNING (spec-completeness gap, self-flagged by apply report and confirmed real). No blocking SUGGESTIONs.**

## Spec → test coverage
Every requirement/scenario in specs/sdd-stage-set/spec.md (both amendments present: reorder REFUSED not normalized; sdd.stages is an object keyed by stage name) maps to a named passing test in brain/scripts/lib/sdd-layout.test.mjs: zero-config identity (#456 1.1 x2), additive declaration (#456 1.5), omission naming 1/2 stages (#456 1.3 x2), empty-object-is-zero-config (#456 1.3), non-canonical order REFUSED + message states order (#456 1.3 x2), four+custom succeeds / interleave legal (#456 1.5, #456 1.3), unknown-stage-with-file / without-file (#456 1.5, #456), single source of truth (2.1-2.5, 5.1-5.2, A3 suite), drift guard bare-name catch (5.1), SCAFFOLD/GATE/routable separation (6.1), routing refusal unmodified (6.2 + stage-engine.test.mjs byte-identical). Zero untested scenario.

**Confirmed real deviation**: design D5's third refusal (declared artefact collides with existing lifecycle file) is implemented (sdd-layout.mjs:165-182) and tested (sdd-layout.test.mjs:316-328) but has NO spec.md Scenario under either "Missing lifecycle stage refusal" or "Unknown stage name refusal". This is WARNING-1 — recommend adding the scenario before treating spec.md as final/archived. Does not block on correctness (code matches design authority and is tested).

## Load-bearing invariants — verified in the tree
1. `git diff -- brain/scripts/lib/stage-engine.test.mjs` → empty. Byte-for-byte unmodified (ADR-0019 Amendment 1 condition 4).
2. `REQUIRED_ARTIFACTS` stays `export const` (sdd-layout.mjs:88, Object.freeze(artefactFiles(LIFECYCLE_STAGES))) — cites-resolve.test.mjs:162 probe assertion passes (ran file in isolation: pass, plus full suite).
3. `git status --porcelain -- brain/core/ brain/project/` → empty. `git diff --stat -- brain/core/config-migrations.mjs` → empty. Nothing Tier 3 written.

## Zero-config identity — proven
resolveStageSet(undefined) and resolveStageSet({}) both deep-equal the canonical four/order/files. REQUIRED_ARTIFACTS and requiredArtifactsFor(tier) unchanged at all 3 tiers. assertRoutableStage still refuses all four even with a custom stage declared. Brain's own brain.config.json has no sdd key — repo is the live zero-config fixture and npm test passing end-to-end exercises this for real.

## Drift guard — proven to catch reintroduction
5.1 trap fixture proves scanForRivalStageArray fires on a re-introduced bare-name declaration. Allowlist scoped to exact path (governance-tiers.mjs twin at different path DOES trip). 5.2 real-tree scan returns zero (proves Phases 2-3 landed). Allowlist entry (sdd-layout.test.mjs:783-786) carries written reason citing REQ-L4-2′, matched against TIER_PARAMS at governance-tiers.mjs:219 (name/path confirmed).

## Single source of truth
rg for bare `['proposal','spec','design','tasks']` across brain/scripts/** (excl *.test.mjs) returns exactly 2 hits: sdd-layout.mjs:76 (the owner, excluded by design) and governance-tiers.mjs:240 (the one allowlisted, reasoned GATE-set exception). No third rival. stage-engine.mjs and phase-order-check.mjs both now import LIFECYCLE_STAGES.

## Phase 4 — confirmed DRAFT only
config-migrations.mjs untouched (git diff empty). brain-drafts/config-migrations-0.11.0.md contains the exact migration entry plus companion test edits for both brain-config.test.mjs and stage-engine.test.mjs, with sequencing notes. Complete enough for direct human promotion — not a finding. Two more Tier 3 drafts (ADR-0019 citation fix, sdd-layout.md guard-scope fix) also complete.

## Test suite — measured, not trusted
npm test: 4519 pass / 0 fail (exact match to apply-progress claim). npm run repo:check: pass. npm run brain:nav: pass. sdd-layout.test.mjs isolated: 68/68 pass.

## Tasks
tasks.md: 18 checked + 3 unchecked = 21 across 7 phases (matches brief). Unchecked = exactly Phase 4 (4.1-4.3), consistent with draft-only status. No task checked without matching evidence.

## Out-of-scope note
openspec/config.yaml carries a pre-existing, unrelated strict_tdd change per apply-progress's own note — not evaluated, flagged only so it isn't mistaken for slice-A scope.

**Where**: report written to openspec/changes/issue-456-stage-set/verify-report.md in the worktree (hybrid store — file + engram both written, no commit/push performed, read-only verification).
